title: quercus stellata var. drummondii
intro: Quercus stellata var. drummondii, commonly known as Drummond's oak or var. drummondii, is a variety of the Quercus stellata tree, native to North America. This deciduous tree is known for its medicinal properties, where it has been used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Quercus stellata var. drummondii include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, making it effective in soothing skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
